environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a basic TCP load balancer (NLB). The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080. The X-User-Id header is set by an upstream nginx reverse proxy based on a session cookie lookup, but the NLB forwards traffic on port 8080 directly accessible from the internal VPC subnet 10.0.0.0/16. Internal services can reach the app directly bypassing nginx. SQLite database file has read-write permissions for the app user. No query filtering or input validation middleware is present.

config.network: internal VPC 10.0.0.0/16, port 8080 open to subnet
config.auth_proxy: nginx on same host, but bypassable via direct port access
config.database: SQLite with full read-write, no row-level security
